basic_details.job_title: IGRUA Ground Instructor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

important_dates.interview_date: As required (links shared on email a day before)

age_limit.details: Maximum 65 Years as on the last date for receipt of applications (29/10/2026).

qualification.details: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.

salary_details.details: In addition to the monthly remuneration, candidates receive a Transport Allowance of ₹3,600 per month and an Aviation Allowance of ₹300 per month.

selection_process: an online interview/written test as required
how_to_apply: Check eligibility criteria and prepare your CV and self-attested copies of certificates.
Organize the documents in the correct order: first the CV, followed by educational certificates from 10th onward, and then experience certificates from earliest to latest.
Combine all documents into a single PDF file.
Send the application via email to career[at]igrua[dot]gov[dot]in.
Clearly mention the title of the advertised post in the subject line: “APPLICATION - GROUND INSTRUCTOR (AIR REGULATIONS) IGRUA/ADVT/35/2026”.
Ensure the application is received on or before the last date, 29/10/2026.
important_instructions: Applications not accompanied by self-attested copies of requisite qualification and experience certificates will be treated as incomplete and rejected. Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Online interviews will be conducted as required, and links will be shared on the candidate's email ID one day prior. Mere submission of an application does not confer any right to be called for the selection process or appointment. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test or interview. The appointment is purely contractual for 11 months (extendible) and confers no right for regular appointment or absorption. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Courts in Lucknow only will have jurisdiction for any disputes.

content_sections.heading: IGRUA Ground Instructor (Air Regulations) Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.

rows.qualification_required: Post-Graduate degree in any discipline from recognized University; AND Held or holding CPL/ATPL; OR Air Traffic Controller from AAI/Defence Forces; OR Minimum 10 years professional experience in civil aviation regulatory domain, airline operations, or aviation safety management; AND Teaching Experience: Minimum 05 years teaching/instructional experience in aviation-related subjects at Flying Training Organisations (DGCA approved), Defence Aviation Training Establishments, Universities/Colleges offering aviation programmes, or AAI training centres.
